summary.zh: Air2Protein · 电—生物催化营养合成

description.zh: Air2Protein 是 BUCT 提出的模块化电—生物催化平台，面向火星大气资源利用与营养生产。平台通过电催化将 CO₂ 转化为甲酸／甲酸盐，以氨作为受控氮源，并评估 N₂ 制氨作为长期氮源供给模块。工程大肠杆菌通过还原甘氨酸途径将甲酸来源的一碳单元导入中心代谢，支持单细胞蛋白和氨基酸积累；β-丙氨酸支路用于 L-肌肽生产。系统面向火星原位食物制造，也考虑地球极端、资源受限环境中的应用。
description.en: Air2Protein is BUCT's modular electro-biocatalytic platform for Martian atmospheric resource utilization and nutrition production. Electrocatalysis converts CO₂ into formate/formic acid, with ammonia supplied as a controlled nitrogen input and N₂-to-NH₃ conversion evaluated as a long-term nitrogen-supply module. Engineered E. coli uses the reductive glycine pathway to channel formate-derived one-carbon units into central metabolism, supporting single-cell protein and amino acid accumulation; a β-alanine branch supports L-carnosine production. The system targets in-situ food production on Mars and applications in extreme, resource-limited environments on Earth.
